notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. The only lookout page for Benham Spur is a header with county and 'Removed'; the index gives the same county. No survey datasheet, register entry or newspaper account was found, and no staffing, construction or fire history. The link between the lookout's name and the ridge is by name only: no source says the tower stands on Benham Spur. The town history comes second-hand through KNOWOL; check the Kentucky Atlas and Gazetteer original before publishing. The record's point (36.9531 N, 82.9762 W) is roughly 2 km southwest of the Wikipedia coordinates for Benham (36.9647 N, 82.9536 W); that is my own calculation and was not checked on a map. No photos.
